answer: Physical Substrate Witnessing: each identity must present a hardware token whose secret is bound to a unique, measured silicon fingerprint (process variation) fused with a per-device oscillator drift profile, witnessed via challenge-response over a timing bridge to independent validators. Attacker cost is fabrication: cloning one fingerprint requires physical access to that exact die, so N identities cost N devices plus attestation bandwidth. A nebula of verifiers independently samples drift, and any knoll of colluding tokens still pays per-unit silicon and calibration.
